## AI-Generated Fix (javascript)

```javascript
const express = require('express');
const helmet = require('helmet');
const app = express();

// Use Helmet to hide the X-Powered-By header
app.use(helmet.hidePoweredBy());

// Serve static files without disclosing version
app.use('/static', express.static('public', {
  setHeaders: (res, path, stat) => {
    res.set('Cache-Control', 'public, max-age=31536000');
    // Remove version information from headers
    res.removeHeader('X-Powered-By');
  }
}));

app.listen(8882, () => {
  console.log('Server running on http://34.16.47.248:8882');
});
```

## Explanation

The vulnerability was due to the disclosure of the Font Awesome version, which could allow attackers to exploit known vulnerabilities. The fix involves using the Helmet middleware in an Express.js application to hide the X-Powered-By header, which often reveals server technology and version information. Additionally, static files are served with headers that do not disclose version information, enhancing security by preventing version fingerprinting.
